# Fidelity Investments

> > Comprehensive financial services platform offering brokerage, retirement planning, 529 college savings plans, annuities, and fintech research through FCAT.

Fidelity Investments provides investment management, retirement services, and financial planning through a nationwide network of Investor Centers. The site features products including the CHET 529 college savings plan, variable annuities, and emerging fintech research on blockchain, Bitcoin mining, and digital assets.

## Key Topics

- Brokerage Services
- Financial Planning
- 529 College Savings Plans (CHET)
- Retirement Savings
- Variable Annuities
- Investor Centers
- Strategic Advisers LLC
- FCAT (Fidelity Center for Applied Technology)
- Blockchain and Digital Assets
- Investment Advisory
- SIPC Protection
- Medicare Services
- Age-Based Portfolios
- Bitcoin Mining Research

## College Savings & 529 Plans

- [CHET Investment Options | Connecticut Higher Education Trust (CHET) | Fidelity](https://www.fidelity.com/about-chet/investment-options): CHET 529 plan investment options and age-based portfolios
- [El plan de ahorros universitarios CHET 529 Connecticut Higher Education Trust (CHET) | Fidelity](https://www.fidelity.com/about-chet/espanol/overview): CHET 529 college savings plan overview in Spanish

## Annuities & Retirement Products

- [New York Life Premier Variable Annuity - P Series | Fidelity](https://www.fidelity.com/annuities/new-york-life-premier-variable-annuity/overview): New York Life Premier Variable Annuity P Series with investment protection

## Fintech Research & Innovation

- [Fintech | FCAT research driving finance innovation](https://www.fidelity.com/fcatalyst/observations/fintech): FCAT fintech research on blockchain, AI, and quantum innovation
- [Observation - Mining](https://www.fidelity.com/fcatalyst/observations/mining): Bitcoin mining research on hashrate, trends, and renewable energy
